extra-1ecdf25661fa.zh-Hans: 创作一个短篇动漫风格美食视频，展示烤肉串和新鲜石榴饮品的分步制作过程：厨师将生红肉切成均匀的肉块，用香料调味，然后打开一颗熟石榴，将果汁和石榴籽挤入碗中。把果汁倒入装有冰块和气泡混合饮料的高杯中，再用薄荷装饰。将调味好的肉块与辣椒和洋葱一起串起烤制，把多汁的烤串配上新鲜欧芹装盘，并与冰镇石榴饮品一起精美呈现。

extra-b35c2b9e6a8d.zh-Hans:
【核心规则】

1.零延迟衔接：招式与招式之间零缓冲，一击未落、下一击已出，剑刃始终保持高频接触。
2.动作驱动场景转换（关键）：任何场景变化（柱身→地面→横梁→大殿）必须由人物的具体动作完成——例如"男主被震退撞向殿柱""女主借力从柱顶翻身跃下砸向地面""两人缠斗中撞穿一排烛台滚落台阶"——绝不允许镜头单独切换场景而人物动作不连续。
3.真实力量感：每一次剑刃相击都要有清晰的身体位移反馈——被格挡的一方手臂震退半步、脚下打滑、身体因冲击力扭转——不是"两人站定互砍"，而是每一下都带着真实的体重和冲力。
4.禁止空转镜头：任何时候镜头运动（推近、环绕、甩镜）必须跟随人物正在进行的具体肢体动作，禁止画面出现人物静止而镜头单独旋转/环绕的情况。
5.贴身险招库：全片穿插以下具体招式，且不重复：
•贴地躲闪：一方横扫斩来，另一方猛然后仰几乎贴地，剑锋堪堪掠过鼻尖，发丝被削断
•直刺反击：躲闪的同时反手直刺，剑尖笔直突刺而出
•旋身格挡：被直刺方原地急速旋身躲开，同时手腕翻转格挡下一击
•翻滚起身反击：被打退跌地的一方就地翻滚，借旋转之力直接刺出反击
•剑锋绞缠近身：两剑绞在一起后，双方近距离肩靠肩角力，忽然同时脱手推开重新拉开架势

【分镜控制 0:00–0:30，全程动作连续无跳切】

[0:00–0:02] 35mm广角，低角度地面轨道镜头，紧跟人物冲刺
女主与男主同时从大殿两端全速冲刺而来，在殿中央剑刃相击的瞬间发力对撞，冲击力震得两人各自后退半步、脚下地砖迸裂溅起碎屑——开场即是全力对撞，无任何铺垫。

[0:02–0:07] 50mm中景转特写，镜头紧贴人物身体运动，快速手持跟拍
近战组1：男主大幅横扫斩来，女主猛然后仰几乎贴地躲避，剑锋堪堪从她鼻尖上方划过，发丝被削断飘散；女主借后仰反弹之力顺势翻身站起同时反手直刺男主胸前；男主急速旋身躲开的同时手腕翻转格挡，两剑绞在一起，双方肩靠肩角力两秒后同时发力震开，各自后退两步喘息。

[0:07–0:09] 85mm长焦跟拍，人物动作驱动的场景转换
男主被震开的力道带得撞向身后龙柱，借柱身反弹之力翻身跃起，脚踏盘龙浮雕垂直跑上柱身；女主紧接着一个爆发式起跳追上柱身，两人在柱身上剑刃相击两三招，剑刃擦过柱身留下灼痕。

[0:09–0:12] 长焦跟拍转俯冲镜头，人物从高处坠落带动场景切换
男主被逼到柱顶横梁边缘，女主一记重击将他震退坠落，男主借坠落之势在半空中翻身调整姿态，剑尖朝下如同俯冲攻击，重重落回大殿地面的同时挥剑横扫；女主几乎同时从柱身跃下正面接下这一击，两剑相撞火花四溅，双方手臂因冲击力明显震颤——此处完成从柱身到大殿地面的自然场景过渡，全程动作不中断。

[0:12–0:17] 50mm特写，镜头持续跟随人物肢体动作，无空镜转场
近战组2（决战前最密集回合）：女主连续三次变向斩击，速度一次比一次快——男主第一次侧身避开、第二次贴地躲过、第三次干脆矮身钻入她剑锋下方近身，反手横斩女主腰侧；女主凌空后翻堪堪躲开，落地瞬间衣摆被剑气削开一角；男主趁她落地瞬间欺身直刺，女主侧身堪堪避开剑尖擦过肩侧，衣料应声裂开，同时反手一记重击震得男主剑身发出金属哀鸣、虎口震裂似地后退两步。

[0:17–0:21] 超广角跟拍，两人剧烈缠斗中撞向环境
两人剑刃绞缠近身角力，忽然同时脱手震开各自后退，紧接着几乎同时再度暴起冲向对方——这一冲带倒了身旁一排烛台，烛火被撞灭又被剑气余波重新点燃，两人在倒地的烛台与四溅的烛油中继续近身缠斗，剑刃碰撞产生密集火花，地面积水被踏起层层水雾。

[0:21–0:26] 特写转全景交替，剪辑跟随攻防节奏（非空转镜头）
双方招式速度达到全片顶点：斩、刺、格挡、反击在两三秒内连续发生，每一次碰撞都有清晰的身体反馈——女主被震得踉跄半步随即反手补上一剑，男主格挡后手臂剧烈震颤仍强行反击；蓝绿剑气缠绕成螺旋光流，两人的呼吸声与兵刃声交织成密集的节奏感，全程无一帧人物静止。

[0:26–0:29] 超广角全景，剧烈镜头震动，跟随最终对撞
双方在剑锋交汇的瞬间同时使出全力一击，两股能量对撞爆发出席卷全殿的蓝绿交织光潮，冲击波将两人同时震飞后退数米，地砖与柱身被震裂，烛火大片熄灭，烟尘弥漫整个神殿，镜头剧烈震颤后画面渐趋失焦泛白。

[0:29–0:30] 固定机位，画面渐缓
烟雾缓缓弥散，两人分别单膝或站立稳住身形，胸口剧烈起伏、握剑的手因手臂力竭仍在颤抖，残存的烛火星星点点重新亮起，画面定格于两人对峙的宏大空镜。

【通用限制】

绝不重新设计面部。绝不更换服装。绝不替换神殿。绝不引入额外角色。无面部漂移。无服装漂移。无环境漂移。无人物重复。无对白。无旁白。无字幕。无文字。无水印。全程镜头必须跟随人物具体动作运动，禁止人物静止时镜头单独旋转或空转。
extra-b35c2b9e6a8d.en:
[Core rules]

1. Zero-delay connection: zero buffer between moves, one strike not yet landed and the next already out, the blade edges always maintaining high-frequency contact.
2. Action-driven scene transitions (key): any scene change (pillar body→ground→crossbeam→main hall) must be completed by the characters' specific actions—for example "the male lead is knocked back and crashes into the hall pillar" "the female lead uses the momentum to flip down from the top of the pillar and slam toward the ground" "the two, grappling, crash through a row of candlesticks and roll down the steps"—absolutely forbidden for the camera to switch scenes on its own while the characters' actions are discontinuous.
3. Real sense of power: every blade clash must have clear bodily displacement feedback—the blocked party's arm knocked back half a step, footing slipping, body twisting from the impact force—not "the two stand still and hack at each other," but every blow carrying real body weight and impact force.
4. No idle camera: at any time camera movement (push-in, orbit, whip pan) must follow the characters' specific ongoing body actions, forbidden for the frame to show characters motionless while the camera rotates/orbits on its own.
5. Close-quarters risky move library: the entire film intercuts the following specific moves, without repetition:
• Ground-hugging dodge: one side sweeps a horizontal slash, the other suddenly leans far back almost touching the ground, the blade edge barely grazing past the tip of the nose, strands of hair sliced off
• Thrust counter: while dodging, a backhand straight thrust, the sword tip stabbing straight out
• Spinning parry: the one being thrust at rapidly spins in place to dodge, while the wrist flips to parry the next strike
• Roll-up counter: the one knocked back and falling to the ground rolls in place, using the rotational force to directly thrust out a counter
• Blade-edge entanglement close-quarters: after the two swords twist together, both sides shoulder-to-shoulder grapple at close range, then suddenly simultaneously release and push apart to re-establish their stances

[Storyboard control 0:00–0:30, continuous action throughout with no jump cuts]

[0:00–0:02] 35mm wide angle, low-angle ground track shot, closely following the characters' sprint
The female lead and male lead simultaneously sprint at full speed from opposite ends of the main hall, at the instant their blade edges clash in the center of the hall they exert force and collide, the impact force shaking both into each stepping back half a step, the floor tiles beneath their feet cracking and splintering—the opening is a full-force collision, with no buildup whatsoever.

[0:02–0:07] 50mm medium shot to close-up, camera hugging the characters' body movements, rapid handheld tracking
Close combat group 1: the male lead slashes with a large horizontal swing, the female lead suddenly leans far back almost touching the ground to dodge, the blade edge barely passing above the tip of her nose, strands of hair sliced off and drifting away; the female lead uses the rebound force of the lean-back to smoothly flip up to standing while backhand thrusting straight at the male lead's chest; the male lead rapidly spins to dodge while his wrist flips to parry, the two swords twist together, both sides shoulder-to-shoulder grappling for two seconds then simultaneously exert force to blast apart, each stepping back two steps panting.

[0:07–0:09] 85mm telephoto tracking, character-action-driven scene transition
The male lead, carried by the force of being blasted back, crashes into the dragon pillar behind him, uses the pillar's rebound force to flip and leap up, stepping on the coiled dragon relief to run vertically up the pillar body; the female lead immediately follows with an explosive jump onto the pillar body, the two clash blade against blade for two or three moves on the pillar body, the blade edges scraping past the pillar body leaving scorch marks.

[0:09–0:12] Telephoto tracking to dive shot, characters falling from height driving the scene switch
The male lead is forced to the edge of the crossbeam at the top of the pillar, the female lead knocks him back with a heavy blow into falling, the male lead uses the falling momentum to flip and adjust his posture in midair, sword tip pointing down like a diving attack, heavily landing back on the main hall floor while swinging a horizontal slash; the female lead almost simultaneously leaps down from the pillar body and meets this blow head-on, the two swords colliding with sparks flying, both arms visibly trembling from the impact force—here the natural scene transition from the pillar body to the main hall floor is completed, with the action uninterrupted throughout.

[0:12–0:17] 50mm close-up, camera continuously following the characters' limb movements, no empty-shot transitions
Close combat group 2 (the densest exchange before the decisive battle): the female lead delivers three consecutive direction-changing slashes, each faster than the last—the male lead dodges the first by turning sideways, dodges the second by hugging the ground, and on the third simply ducks low and slips in beneath her blade edge at close range, backhand slashing horizontally at the female lead's waist; the female lead flips backward in midair barely dodging, at the instant of landing the hem of her garment is sliced open at one corner by the sword aura; the male lead, taking advantage of her landing instant, closes in and thrusts straight, the female lead turns sideways barely dodging as the sword tip grazes past her shoulder, the fabric splitting with the sound, while a backhand heavy blow shakes the male lead's blade into a metallic groan, the web of his hand seemingly split as he steps back two steps.

[0:17–0:21] Ultra-wide-angle tracking, the two crash into the environment amid violent grappling
The two's blade edges twist together in close-quarters grappling, then suddenly simultaneously release and blast apart each stepping back, immediately after almost simultaneously erupting again and charging at each other—this charge knocks over a row of candlesticks beside them, the candle flames blown out then reignited by the residual sword aura, the two continue close-quarters grappling among the fallen candlesticks and splashing candle oil, the blade collisions producing dense sparks, the standing water on the ground stepped into layers of mist.

[0:21–0:26] Close-up to wide shot alternating, editing following the attack-defense rhythm (not idle camera)
Both sides' move speed reaches the peak of the entire film: slash, thrust, parry, counter occur continuously within two or three seconds, every collision has clear bodily feedback—the female lead shaken into a half-step stagger then immediately backhand adding a slash, the male lead after parrying his arm violently trembling yet still forcing a counter; blue-green sword auras entwine into a spiral light stream, the two's breathing sounds and weapon sounds interweaving into a dense sense of rhythm, not a single frame with the characters motionless throughout.

[0:26–0:29] Ultra-wide-angle wide shot, violent camera shake, following the final collision
Both sides at the instant their blade edges meet simultaneously unleash a full-force strike, the two energy forces colliding and erupting into a blue-green interwoven light tide sweeping the entire hall, the shockwave blasting both flying back several meters simultaneously, floor tiles and pillar bodies cracked by the shock, large swaths of candle flames extinguished, smoke and dust filling the entire temple, the camera violently shaking then the frame gradually becoming unfocused and whitening.

[0:29–0:30] Fixed camera position, frame gradually slowing
Smoke slowly disperses, the two respectively steady themselves on one knee or standing, chests heaving violently, the sword-gripping hands still trembling from arm exhaustion, the remaining candle flames flickering back to life bit by bit, the frame freezing on a grand empty shot of the two in standoff.

[General restrictions]

Never redesign faces. Never change costumes. Never replace the temple. Never introduce additional characters. No face drift. No costume drift. No environment drift. No duplicated people. No dialogue. No narration. No subtitles. No text. No watermark. The camera must follow the characters' specific actions throughout, forbidden for the camera to rotate or idle on its own while the characters are motionless.
